study_identification_part.si4_title: Individual differences v. the average patient: mapping the heterogeneity in ADHD using normative models

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Use normative modeling to quantify and map individual-level deviations in brain structure in adults with persistent ADHD relative to normative aging, and compare individual heterogeneity with group-level case–control differences.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Adults with persistent ADHD show mean gray matter reductions in cerebellum and hippocampus relative to controls, but individual extreme deviations are highly heterogeneous with minimal spatial overlap (>2% of patients in only a few loci).
